The '''SoroSuub Research, Development and Engineering Center''' was a scientific organization working for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].

==History==
It worked on SoroSuub Corporation designs, including the [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]].
